context_for_next_testing_agent:
Iteration 4 adds sidebar layout and 5 new pages. All backend APIs tested:

ROSTER MANAGEMENT:
- GET /api/roster/{team_id} - Returns roster with fantasy points per player
- POST /api/roster/{team_id}/add - Adds player (validates ownership, roster limit, duplicates)
- POST /api/roster/{team_id}/drop - Drops player (validates ownership, player on roster)

SCORING ENGINE:
- POST /api/scoring/config - Saves scoring config (commissioner only)
- GET /api/scoring/config?league_id=X - Returns config (defaults if none saved)
- GET /api/scoring/calculate/{league_id} - Calculates fantasy points per team
- GET /api/scoring/roto/{league_id} - Calculates rotisserie standings

FRONTEND PAGES WITH SIDEBAR:
- /trade-block - Trade block with filters, add modal
- /transactions - Pending/Accepted/All trades tabs
- /waivers - FAAB budget, available players, claims
- /roster - Team roster with add/drop
- /scoring - Points-based and rotisserie config

All existing features (auth, leagues, teams, players, drafts, trades, waivers) continue to work.
